turns.question: What are total sales per customer?
turns.resolved: What are the total sales for each customer across all available history?
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(so.total_amount), 2) AS total_sales
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN sales_customers c ON c.id = so.customer_id
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

turns.question: How many Centrifugal Pumps have we sold?
turns.resolved: How many Centrifugal Pumps have we sold across all time?
turns.sql:
SELECT i.item_code,
       i.name AS item_name,
       SUM(sol.ordered_quantity) AS quantity_sold
FROM sales_order_lines sol
JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = sol.order_id
JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = sol.item_id
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND i.name ILIKE '%centrifugal pump%'
GROUP BY i.id, i.item_code, i.name
ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC

turns.question: Average number of lines per sales order in 2025
turns.resolved: What was the average number of lines per sales order for Volume Perf from January 1 through December 31, 2025?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(sol.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT so.id), 0), 2) AS avg_lines_per_sales_order
FROM sales_orders so

WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

turns.question: Sales in December 2024 versus December 2025
turns.resolved: Compare sales from December 1–31, 2024 with sales from December 1–31, 2025 for Volume Perf.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  ), 0), 2) AS sales_december_2024,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  ), 0), 2) AS sales_december_2025
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND (
    (so.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01')
    OR
    (so.order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01')
  )

turns.question: Which weekday gets the most orders?
turns.resolved: Which weekday has the most sales orders across all available dates?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(so.order_date, 'FMDay') AS weekday,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM so.order_date), TO_CHAR(so.order_date, 'FMDay')

turns.question: List all revenue and expense accounts with their balances
turns.resolved: List all Acme revenue and expense accounts with their balances through September 27, 2026.
turns.sql:
SELECT a.code AS account_code,
       a.name AS account_name,
       a.account_type,
       ROUND(
           CASE
               WHEN a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
                   THEN COALESCE(b.total_credit, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_debit, 0)
               ELSE COALESCE(b.total_debit, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_credit, 0)
           END,
           2
       ) AS balance
FROM fin_accounts a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT jl.account_id,
           SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount) AS total_debit,
           SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount) AS total_credit
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date <= DATE '2026-09-27'
    GROUP BY jl.account_id
) b ON b.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.account_type IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE')
ORDER BY a.account_type, a.code

turns.question: What was revenue each month in 2025?
turns.resolved: What was Volume Perf's revenue for each calendar month from January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025?
turns.sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE '2025-01-01',
        DATE '2025-12-01',
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    )::date AS month
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount) AS revenue
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
      AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date
)
SELECT m.month,
       ROUND(COALESCE(mr.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue mr ON mr.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month

turns.question: Add the cost of goods sold next to it
turns.resolved: What were Volume Perf's revenue and cost of goods sold for each calendar month from July 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025, shown side by side?
turns.sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE '2025-07-01',
        DATE '2025-12-01',
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    )::date AS month
),
monthly_amounts AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE') AS revenue,
           SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                   SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                   FROM inv_item_categories ic
               )) AS cost_of_goods_sold
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date
)
SELECT m.month,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ma.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ma.cost_of_goods_sold, 0), 2) AS cost_of_goods_sold
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly_amounts ma ON ma.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month

turns.question: Which of those months had the best margin?
turns.resolved: Which calendar month from July 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025 had the highest gross margin percentage for Volume Perf, calculated as (revenue minus cost of goods sold) divided by revenue?
turns.sql:
WITH monthly_amounts AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE') AS revenue,
           SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                   SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                   FROM inv_item_categories ic
               )) AS cost_of_goods_sold
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date
)
SELECT ma.month,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * (COALESCE(ma.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(ma.cost_of_goods_sold, 0))
           / NULLIF(ma.revenue, 0),
           2
       ) AS gross_margin_percentage
FROM monthly_amounts ma
ORDER BY gross_margin_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
